entities.note: grey reversed-L of five 3x3 cells (rows 15-23, cols 18-26: 3-cell bar on top, 2 cells hanging at its right); each cell has a 1-px black(0) centre dot marking it as the selected object
yellow reflection of shape5 across the blue axis (rows 15-23, cols 36-44); same handedness as the target L; moves opposite to the shape in x, same in y
vertical 3-px blue line at cols 30-32, rows 0-62: the mirror axis; fixed and unselectable at L1 (movable in later levels)
five 3x3 blue dots at rows 45-53, cols 51-59 forming an L (bar on top, 2 cells hanging at its LEFT) = the mirror image of shape5
col 63 rows 0-62: colour 11 = remaining energy, drained from the top to colour 5 as moves are spent (64 steps at L1); row 63 is a colour-5 letterbox

rules.note: up one grid cell (3 px); costs 1 energy
the yellow image moves up with the shape
the yellow image moves down with the shape
the yellow image moves RIGHT (mirrored) when the shape moves left
the yellow image moves LEFT (mirrored) when the shape moves right
any move that would push the shape outside the 21x21 grid (display 0-62) is ignored and costs no energy; same for ACTION2/3/4. Shapes never collide with the axis or each other
cycles the selection through movable objects, but at L1 only the shape is selectable (the axis is fixed), so nothing visible happens; still costs 1 energy
selects the shape under the click; it is already selected at L1 so no visible change; free
clicks elsewhere (axis, targets, background) do nothing and cost no energy; the fixed axis cannot be selected
undo: moves the shape (and its mirror) back to where it was before the last successful move; free, but the spent energy is not refunded

goal.note: every blue target dot must be covered by a cell of the yellow mirror image (or of the shape itself, impossible at L1 because the target L has the opposite handedness); shape at grid (1,15) = display rows 3-11, cols 3-11; 15 moves minimum
